headline: 10-year Treasury yield nears 5%
detail: Rising yields put pressure on growth and tech stocks, which is your core area. This could continue to weigh on your leveraged ETFs like SOXL and SPAL.
rec: No action warranted by this headline alone, but monitor yield movements for further impact on your holdings.

headline: AI has been carrying the stock market. An industry pause could pull the rug out, warns this Wall Street giant.
detail: With ~90% of your book in tech/chips, any slowdown or pause in AI development or adoption poses a significant risk. This could directly impact names like NVDA and your leveraged ETFs.
rec: Consider trimming QQQI (currently -3.28%) as a defensive measure against potential AI sector weakness.

headline: Brent crude tops $109 after Saudi Arabia shuts down critical pipeline
detail: Rising oil prices and Middle East tensions could lead to broader inflation concerns, potentially influencing Fed policy and market sentiment. This is less direct for your tech focus but adds to market choppiness.
rec: This headline does not directly warrant a change in your tech-heavy holdings.
